entries.title: II Corinthians 2:1
segments: But I determined this within myself, that I would not come to you again in grief.

entries.title: II Corinthians 2:2
segments: For if I make you sorry, who then is he who makes me glad, but the same who has been made sorry by me?

entries.title: II Corinthians 2:3
segments: And I wrote this to you, lest when I came I should have sorrow from the [ones] of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all, that my joy is [the joy] of you all.

entries.title: II Corinthians 2:4
segments: For out of much trouble and anguish of heart I wrote to you with many tears, not that you should be grieved, but that you might know the love which I have more abundantly to you.

entries.title: II Corinthians 2:5
segments: But if anyone has caused grief, he has not grieved me, except in part; so that I not overbear all of you.

entries.title: II Corinthians 2:6
segments: This punishment by the majority [is] enough for such a one;

entries.title: II Corinthians 2:7
segments: so that, on the contrary, you should rather forgive and comfort [him], lest perhaps such a one should be swallowed up with overwhelming sorrow.

entries.title: II Corinthians 2:8
segments: So I beseech you to confirm [your] love toward him.

entries.title: II Corinthians 2:9
segments: For to this end I also wrote, that I might know the proof of you, whether you are obedient in all things.

entries.title: II Corinthians 2:10
segments: But to whom you forgive anything, I also [forgive]. For if I forgave anything, for your sakes I forgave [it] to him in the person of Christ;

entries.title: II Corinthians 2:11
segments: so that we should not be overreached by Satan, for we are not ignorant of his devices.

entries.title: II Corinthians 2:12
segments: And, when I came to Troas to [preach] Christ's gospel, and a door was opened to me by [the] Lord,

entries.title: II Corinthians 2:13
segments: I had no rest in my spirit because I did not find Titus my brother. But taking my leave of them, I went from there into Macedonia.

entries.title: II Corinthians 2:14
segments: Now thanks [be] to God, who always causes us to triumph in Christ, and He revealing through us the odor of the knowledge of Him in every place.

entries.title: II Corinthians 2:15
segments: For we are to God a sweet savor of Christ, in those being saved, and in those being lost;

entries.title: II Corinthians 2:16
segments: to the one [we are] the savor of death to death, and to the other we are the savor of life to life. And who is sufficient for these things?

entries.title: II Corinthians 2:17
segments: For we are not as many, hawking the Word of God; but as of sincerity, but as of God. We speak in Christ in the sight of God.
